image_description: A sunny outdoor scene featuring a row of four white golf carts parked in front of a building with a tiled roof. Palm trees and other greenery are visible in the background and foreground. The carts appear to be standard electric models with canopies.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicles are clearly compact, open-sided utility vehicles consistent with the size and shape of golf carts.
